Cloud note: Commands and what plays go over the YouTube Lounge API of Google ("Link with TV"), so an internet connection is needed. Google does not document this API; it may change.
Devices help: Search finds TVs and devices with the YouTube app in the network. Every device can also be paired with the TV code: in the YouTube app under Settings > Link with TV code.
Look up titles: Look up title, channel and picture
Look up titles help: One request to YouTube (oEmbed) per new video
